messages:
jordan: ran the multi-workload bakeoff overnight (summarization, codegen, legal-qa).
jordan: quick summary: AWQ-int8 really helps throughput/cost but we're seeing a per-task accuracy delta: summarization -0.4 ROUGE, codegen ~0.0, legal-qa F1 down 3.6 and hallucination rate up ~4.2% :grimacing:
noah: can you paste the exact metrics and the run config?
jordan: sure — eval command and outputs below
jordan: ```
# cmd
./eval_suite --workloads summarization,codegen,legalqa --models open-gpt-v2:fp16,open-gpt-v2:awq-int8,open-gpt-v2:gptq-fp8 --seed 42 --batch 64 --kv-cache enable

# snippet of results (sampled)
model,workload,metric,delta_vs_fp16
open-gpt-v2:awq-int8,summarization,rougeL,-0.4
open-gpt-v2:awq-int8,codegen,pass@1,0.0
open-gpt-v2:awq-int8,legalqa,f1,-3.6
open-gpt-v2:awq-int8,legalqa,hallucination_rate,+4.2
open-gpt-v2:gptq-fp8,legalqa,f1,-0.8
``` 
maya: interesting that gptq-fp8 only -0.8 on legalqa. is this a formatting/JSON structure regression or factual hallucination? any pattern in failure cases?
jordan: looked at samples — many legalqa failures are short-answer Qs where model outputs an extra boilerplate sentence that is incorrect but plausible. formatting still valid JSON in most fails, so not just parse errors.
noah: did tokenizer change between conversion runs? AWQ pipeline used quant-convert v1.3, GPTQ used v1.1 maybe.
sara: also saw more truncation warnings in awq logs for long contexts. could be off-by-one in KV cache indexing after quant conversion.
jordan: logs show repeated warning: "kv_cache_mismatch: expected 512 actual 511" for AWQ-int8 during long dialogue traces.
jordan: ```
# partial log
[2026-02-12T03:21:10Z] worker-5 WARN kv_cache_mismatch: expected 512 actual 511 at transformer/block_22
[2026-02-12T03:21:10Z] worker-5 WARN token_shift_detected: shift=1
``` 
maya: kv cache mismatch could explain hallucination if attention windows misaligned. any code diffs in codegen used by awq runner?
noah: I traced quantizer: awq/grouping.py recently got a change that pads last shard with zeros instead of repeating last value. Could introduce an off-by-one when kernel assumes gutter is filled with last token state.
sara: do we have a quick repro? smallest failing prompt that triggers hallucination?
jordan: yes — sending two examples (legalqa prompts) in a gist link: https://internal.gists/redwood/awq-legalqa-examples
jordan: example 1: "What statute governs X in Y?" expected short citation; AWQ returned citation + invented case law paragraph.
maya: can we bisect on quant-convert v1.2 -> v1.3 and grouping.py change? run a quick binary search across commits in CI.
ci-bot: @eng-ml triggered job #build-quant-bisect-178 for commit range 1a2b..3c4d. logs: https://ci.redwood/build-quant-bisect-178
ci-bot: job started, estimated 25m ETA
noah: parallel idea: run eval with tokenizer.normalize_digits=false to rule out subtle normalization differences.
jordan: also tried running AWQ with pad_mode=repeat (workaround) and hallucination rate dropped to +1.1% (still not baseline). so pad strategy is a big signal.
maya: gptq-fp8 didn't have that grouping change so far which matches smaller delta.
sara: for rollback plan: hold canary for AWQ-int8, revert grouping.py change in quant-convert, run full multiworkload overnight. we should also add unit test that exercises kv_cache length invariants.
jordan: agree. raising PR to revert + test now.
jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-convert/pull/492
jordan: adding a short-term mitigation: in runtime, detect kv length mismatch and realign by trimming/zero-extending before attention (cost ~0.2ms). pushing patch to canary cluster.
maya: :thumbsup: good plan. please tag infra for canary rollout: @oncall-runtime.
noah: one more ask: capture top-100 failing prompts and cluster them by token-length and prompt-format. I'll run that job and attach clusters tomorrow.
jordan: noted. summary action items:
- revert quant-convert grouping change (jordan)
- add kv length invariant unit test (sara)
- canary runtime patch to realign kv cache (maya + eng-sre)
- collect and cluster failing prompts (noah)

eng-ml-bot: incident-note created: ML-REG-2026-02-AWQ-HALLUC-1, severity=high, owners=[jordan,maya,noah]
jordan: thanks all. will update thread with bisect results and canary metrics when available. :eyes:
